mapper.select: WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM fin_account_payable WHERE id>#{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}) SELECT coalesce(max(b.id),#{afterId}) AS cursor,count(*) AS rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.written_off_amount != coalesce((SELECT sum(s.amount) FROM fin_settlement_record s WHERE s.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND s.bill_type='AP' AND s.bill_id=b.id),0) OR b.paid_amount != coalesce((SELECT sum(c.amount) FROM fin_payment c WHERE c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.bill_id=b.id),0) OR b.credited_amount != coalesce((SELECT -sum(c.amount) FROM fin_credit_adjustment c WHERE c.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND c.bill_type='AP' AND c.bill_id=b.id),0)) AS mismatches FROM page b
